DSH Usage adds a Web usage panel to the DSH sidebar. It summarizes project tokens, development time, estimated costs, timelines and trends. Users can check configured account balances, adjust model prices, and export CSV or JSON. It includes a pricing catalog and needs no extra API key.

text: @rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 命令行安装：两条命令里的 `-w` 是 pnpm 的 workspace 安装选项，不是文件路径。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 桌面端：用桌面应用自带的 CLI 安装（macOS 路径如下，其他系统用应用目录里对应的 `dsh`）：

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin \
  --profile desktop add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats
```

装完完整退出 DSH（macOS 用 Cmd+Q，不是只关窗口），再重新打开。侧边栏底部的「用量」就是入口。

桌面 profile 由应用自己管理：用 npm 单独安装的 `dsh` 会直接拒绝操作 `desktop` profile。更多细节见[使用指南](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#11-桌面端)。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Web：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats
```

然后重启 Web 宿主（`dsh web`），刷新页面。只刷新浏览器不会重新加载宿主侧插件。

自定义 profile 把 `desktop` / `web` 换成实际名称即可。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 🖼️ 界面：面板有四个标签页，头部固定显示数据来源状态、刷新、导出、计价设置和关闭。插件版本和项目仓库入口在计价设置「模型价格」列表的底部，点击会在新窗口打开 GitHub。

键盘：`Tab` 在面板内循环，`Esc` 逐层关闭筛选、菜单和价格抽屉、最后关闭面板，表头按钮按 `Enter` 排序，展开按钮按 `Enter` 展开或收起。
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 项目总览：按项目看用量和预估费用：表格可按任意列排序，展开项目查看轮/步、工具时长、首 token、tok/s 和会话明细；右上角可以搜索并隐藏项目，隐藏的项目不计入指标和趋势。项目每页 50 个、会话每页 100 条，翻页不改变顶部汇总。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 用量趋势：范围可选近 7 / 30 / 90 天，指标可在费用和 Token 之间切换。上方摘要给出区间合计、日均和最常用模型，中间是每日柱图，下面是固定 26 周的活动热力图，末尾按当前指标列出模型占比。点柱子或热力格会跳到那天的总览。
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 账户余额：一屏列出所有已接入账户，按紧急程度排序：额度或余额快用完、凭证失效、快照过期的账户排在最前面。多账户时顶部按币种合计可用余额，并给出最紧的额度和需要关注的账户数。每个余额账户可以设一条提醒线，只保存在当前浏览器。
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 计价设置：头部的齿轮图标打开计价设置抽屉，固定三个分区：模型价格、自定义规则、更新与版本。模型价格里可以搜索模型、查看当前规则和历史规则；自定义规则填好后先「预览影响」再保存；更新与版本管理自动更新开关、固定版本和历史目录快照。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 💰 数据与费用：- **费用是估算**。价格按每百万 Token 计算，界面和汇总统一用人民币；USD 原价按固定汇率快照 `1 USD = 6.7205 CNY`（`2026-08-26`，[Frankfurter](https://api.frankfurter.app/2026-08-26?from=USD&to=CNY)）换算，换算后的金额算作估算，不随实时汇率浮动。JSON 导出保留每条用量的原币金额和所用汇率，方便审计。
- **三种金额**：`¥12.34` 是已计价，`¥12.34*` 是部分用量未计价，没有可用规则时显示「待计价」。点费用旁的 ⓘ 看说明。
- **订阅不折算**。订阅和 Token Plan 用量不会变成 API 费用；未知模型、显式 relay/local 且没配费率、规则冲突的会话也不猜价，不计入主汇总。原因在会话详情里，导出保留 `costStatus`、`ruleId`、`pricingSource` 供定位。
- **标题状态点**跟着当前标签页：统计页描述统计数据从哪来（「已同步」「数据不完整」「快照已过期」「本地摘要 · 内置价格」），账户页描述这次账户查询的结果。
- **内容上方的横幅**用另一套文案：「快照已过期」对应「刷新失败，显示上次快照」，「本地摘要 · 内置价格」对应「回退数据，可能不完整」。有错误信息时才展开「数据诊断」；只有状态为过期或回退、且宿主仍提供对应 RPC 时才出现重试。
- **数据来源和单价是两件事**。状态点描述的是数据从哪来，金额本身另有一套 `exact` / `estimated` / `free` / `partial` / `unsupported` 状态。
- **凭证只在宿主侧使用**。账户查询由 DSH 宿主读取凭证并请求各 Provider 的官方接口，凭证不进入前端 bundle、RPC 日志或 CSV/JSON 导出。
- **导出范围**。项目总览、开发时间线和用量趋势支持 CSV/JSON，导出的是当前日期或区间选中的项目；账户余额是实时快照，不提供导出。
- **时区**。时间线、峰谷时段和计价规则的生效时间都用北京时间（UTC+8），不受宿主机时区影响。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 💰 数据与费用：计价状态、Provider 匹配规则、自定义规则与目录更新的完整说明见[使用指南的计价部分](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#3-计价与费用)；价格目录的采集和签名见[动态价格设计](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/pricing-updates.md)。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ 常见问题：
装完为什么侧边栏没有「用量」？ 先确认安装命令成功，再完整重启宿主（桌面端退出应用，Web 重启 `dsh web`），浏览器必要时硬刷新。DSH 会缓存客户端模块和 Typert 描述符。确认装的是目标 profile：装到 `web` 不会同时出现在 `desktop`。
为什么费用看起来不全？ 主费用汇总只包含能确认并换算成人民币的金额。订阅用量、未知模型、显式 relay/local、归档且无日志的 fork 都不猜价，因此被排除；原因在会话详情里，导出保留 `costStatus`、`ruleId` 和 `pricingSource`，可以逐条定位。
为什么账户页查不到某个账户？

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ 常见问题：账户查询走各 Provider 的官方余额接口。没有公开接口的 Provider 会列在账户页的「未接入」组并说明原因，Token 统计不受影响；已配置接口但缺少凭证的账户会单独标出缺少的变量名。DeepSeek 的 `deepseek-account` 登录方式没有 API Key，查不到余额。凭证变量和覆盖方式见[使用指南的账户部分](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.md#4-账户与凭证)。
怎么更新？ 重新执行对应 profile 的安装命令并指定目标版本，然后按安装时的方式重启。价格目录是独立更新的：宿主启动时和之后每小时检查签名目录，不需要为调价重装插件。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ⚠️ 已知限制：- 当前会话的 projection cache 可能滞后几秒，面板每 60 秒自动刷新；窗口隐藏时暂停，回到前台时如已超过 60 秒会立即刷新一次。
- 普通归档会话会标注「已归档」；归档、无日志且只有继承 cache 的 fork 会从统计中排除。
- OpenRouter 使用带日期的模型目录快照，这类金额会标记为 `estimated`。
- 同一项目的并发会话在时间线中合并为墙钟区间，项目 LLM/工具时长仍是累计工作量指标。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 🛠️ 开发与文档：```bash

npm run build
npm test

`lib/` 是发布产物，请修改 `src/` 后重新构建，不要手工编辑。`npm run verify:lib` 会重建并检查产物是否已提交；执行一次 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` 后，`pre-push` 会在推送前跑同一项检查。架构、数据契约和性能权衡见 [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/DESIGN.md)，逐版本的模块契约、完整 Web 与浏览器夹具结果见[兼容性矩阵](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md)，`npm run smoke:browser` 使用隔离夹具检查桌面和手机界面。

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Introduction：DSH Usage is a usage dashboard for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), available in the desktop app and on the web. It reads DSH session records and organizes tokens, development time and estimated cost by project, date and model. When a price cannot be confirmed it says so instead of guessing. `(｡•̀ᴗ-)✧`

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Introduction：The UI brand is **DSH Usage**; the install package is still **`@rongyi7/dsh-stats`**, the dependency name existing profiles already use. Both refer to this plugin.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Introduction：


Light mode · real desktop data with sensitive values masked · click for the full overview

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Introduction：> Except for the account balance page, screenshots come from the desktop app; project names, paths, session titles, account names and amounts are masked as xxxx. The balance page still uses isolated fixture demo data. They contain no API keys, cookies, management tokens or session content. Costs are derived from public prices; the provider's bill remains authoritative.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 📦 Installation：The plugin installs into a DSH profile. The desktop app and Web are separate profiles (`desktop` and `web`); installing into one does not install into the other.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Recommended: plugin market (DSH 0.2.1+)：Open **Settings → Plugin market**, search for **`dsh-stats`**, and install in one click.

The market lists come from [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin), where this plugin is now listed ([entry](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/)). If the market does not show it yet, your local index has not synced (it updates once a day) — use the command line below instead.
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Command line：The `-w` flag in both commands is pnpm's workspace install option, not a file path.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Desktop app：Install with the CLI bundled with the desktop app (macOS path below; on other systems use the matching `dsh` inside the app directory):

```bash
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin \
  --profile desktop add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats
```

Then quit DSH completely (Cmd+Q on macOS, not just closing the window) and open it again. The “Usage” entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Desktop app：The desktop profile is managed by the app itself: a `dsh` installed separately from npm refuses to operate on the `desktop` profile. See the [installation section of the guide](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.en.md#11-desktop-app) for details.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Web：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w @rongyi7/dsh-stats
```

Restart the Web host (`dsh web`), then reload the page. Reloading the browser alone does not reload host-side plugins.

For a custom profile, replace `desktop` / `web` with the real profile name.
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Versions and requirements：The plugin requires Node.js 22 or newer. The desktop app ships its own runtime, so no separate Node install is needed there.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Versions and requirements：The npm stable release is `0.5.2` (published 2026-10-28); both the desktop app and Web can install it, and the interface notes below follow this release. `0.5.2` is a resilience patch for pricing-catalog updates: the interface, peer ranges and catalog format are unchanged, and the RPC only gained a few optional fields. The first automatic check waits 15–25 s after mount, transient failures retry with a 5/15/30-minute backoff, and the diagnostics show the actual cause (DNS, timeout, HTTP status or a malformed payload). `0.4.3` declares Harness peers up to `0.2.0-rc.2`; the host's compatibility check lets prereleases participate, so `0.2.1-rc.2` still allows it to load, but it was only verified through `0.2.0-rc.2` — upgrading to `0.5.2` is the verified path.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Versions and requirements：Pinned versions, local tarballs, registration checks, upgrades and pnpm troubleshooting are in the [installation section of the guide](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.en.md#1-installation).

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 🖼️ Interface：The panel has four tabs. The header always shows the data-source status, refresh, export, pricing settings and close. The plugin version and the project repository link sit at the foot of the Models list in pricing settings and open GitHub in a new window.

Keyboard: `Tab` cycles inside the panel; `Esc` closes the filter, menu and pricing drawer one layer at a time and finally the panel; `Enter` sorts from a header button and expands or collapses a row.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Overview：Usage and estimated cost by project: sort by any column, expand a project for turns/steps, tool time, first token, tok/s and session details, and search or hide projects in the top-right. Hidden projects are excluded from metrics and trends. Projects page 50 at a time and sessions 100 at a time; paging never changes the top summary.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Timeline：The day view arranges projects as lanes above half-hour cost or token bars; click a segment or bar for that half hour, or expand a lane to open its sessions. The all view is a calendar matrix, 30 days per page; click a cell to open that day.
@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Timeline：

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Usage trends：Ranges are the last 7, 30 or 90 days, and the metric switches between cost and tokens. The summary strip gives the range total, daily average and top model; daily bars follow, then a fixed 26-week activity heatmap, and a model share table for the current metric. Clicking a bar or heat cell opens that day in the overview.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Account balance：Every connected account appears in one list, ordered by urgency: exhausted or nearly exhausted quotas, invalid credentials and stale snapshots come first. With multiple accounts, the strip totals available balance per currency and shows the tightest quota and how many accounts need attention. Each balance account can have an alert line, saved in this browser only.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · Pricing settings：The gear icon opens the pricing settings drawer with three fixed sections: models, custom rules, and updates & versions. Search models and inspect current and historical rules; fill in a custom rule, preview its impact, then save; manage automatic updates, pinned versions and catalog snapshots.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 💰 Data and cost：- **Costs are estimates.** Rates are per million tokens and the UI and summaries use RMB only. USD list prices are converted with the fixed FX snapshot `1 USD = 6.7205 CNY` (`2026-08-26`, [Frankfurter](https://api.frankfurter.app/2026-08-26?from=USD&to=CNY)), and the converted amount counts as an estimate; live rates are never applied. JSON exports keep each usage row's original-currency amount and the rate used, so amounts stay auditable.
- **Three amounts.** `¥12.34` is priced, `¥12.34*` means some usage is unpriced, and “Awaiting price” means no safe rule applies. The ⓘ next to the cost explains it.
- **Subscriptions are not converted.** Subscription and token-plan usage never becomes API spend; unknown models, explicit relay/local routes without a custom rate, and conflicting rules are not guessed either. They stay out of the primary total; the reason is in session details, and exports keep `costStatus`, `ruleId` and `pricingSource` for tracing.
- **The title status** follows the current tab: on the statistics tabs it describes where the data came from (“Synced”, “Incomplete data”, “Snapshot expired”, “Local summaries · bundled prices

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 💰 Data and cost：Full pricing statuses, provider matching, custom rules and catalog updates are in the [pricing section of the guide](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.en.md#3-pricing); catalog collection and signing are described in the [pricing design](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/pricing-updates.md).

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ FAQ：
Why is the “Usage” entry missing after installing? Confirm the install command succeeded, then fully restart the host (quit the desktop app, or restart `dsh web`) and hard-refresh the browser if needed. DSH caches client modules and Typert descriptors. Also confirm you installed into the profile you are running: installing into `web` does not add the entry to `desktop`.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ FAQ：
Why does the cost look incomplete? The primary total only includes amounts that can be confirmed and converted to RMB. Subscription usage, unknown models, explicit relay/local routes and archived logless forks are not guessed and are therefore excluded; the reason is in session details, and exports keep `costStatus`, `ruleId` and `pricingSource` so each case can be traced.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ FAQ：
Why is an account missing from the balance tab?

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ FAQ：Account queries use each provider's official balance endpoint. Providers without a public endpoint appear in the “not connected” group with a reason, and token statistics are unaffected; an account with an endpoint but no credential shows the missing variable name. DeepSeek's `deepseek-account` sign-in has no API key to query. Credential variables and overrides are in the [accounts section of the guide](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/usage-guide.en.md#4-accounts-and-credentials).
</details>

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ❓ FAQ：
How do I update? Run the install command for that profile again with the target version, then restart the same way you installed. The price catalog updates independently: the host checks the signed catalog at startup and hourly, so a price change needs no reinstall.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · ⚠️ Known limitations：- The session projection cache can lag by a few seconds; the panel refreshes every 60 seconds, pauses while the window is hidden, and refreshes once on return if a full period has passed.
- Ordinary archived sessions are marked “archived”; archived, logless forks backed only by inherited cache are excluded from statistics.
- OpenRouter uses a dated model-catalog snapshot, so those amounts are `estimated`.
- Overlapping sessions in one project merge into wall-clock timeline intervals; project LLM/tool durations remain cumulative work metrics.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats README · 🛠️ Development and docs：`lib/` is generated output: edit `src/`, then rebuild. `npm run verify:lib` rebuilds and checks the bundle is committed; after `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`, the `pre-push` hook runs the same check before every push. Architecture, data contracts and performance trade-offs are in [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/DESIGN.md); per-release module contracts, complete Web runs and browser-fixture results are in the [compatibility matrix](https://github.com/rongyishuaige7/dsh-stats/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md). `npm run smoke:browser` checks the desktop and mobile UI with isolated fixtures.
